findings.severity: HIGH (blocking for founder enrollment; non-blocking for authority safety)
findings.title: The frozen capsule and FINAL unsigned activation template bind the package candidate 58b3620, not the PR head 46f1f0d, so the package does not verify at the head it is submitted as
findings.mechanism: run-five-hour.mjs line 447 enforces PF-5: activation.evidence_commit_sha/tree must equal the mechanically resolved current HEAD/tree. The capsule and its FINAL template were frozen at the package candidate 58b3620. The evidence-only tail commit 46f1f0d then advanced HEAD. From that moment the template no longer binds the current head, and the production capsule verifier's checks 'SYSTEM_STATE binds exact frozen head', 'FINAL template binds exact frozen head' and 'preflight -> SIGNATURE-REQUIRED' all fail. The evidence artifacts asserting the passing result were themselves committed in 46f1f0d — the very commit that falsified them.
reproduction: then repeat both in a disposable clone checked out at 58b36206669a27d1ce6171f0f3149721c24f35c7
findings.actual_result: At HEAD 46f1f0d: preflight = BINDING-DEFECT, binding_defects = ['evidence_commit_sha/tree is not the exact current HEAD/tree']; CAPSULE-VERIFIER = INVALID, 28/31 passed, 3 failed. The committed PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_RESULTS.json instead states result 'SIGNATURE-REQUIRED', binds_exact_final_head true, binding_defects []. PACKAGE_CHECKER_PACKET.md section 13 instructs the Checker to require SIGNATURE-REQUIRED with empty binding_defects, which is mechanically unobtainable at the head it ships with.
findings.required_result: Either (a) the capsule and FINAL template are regenerated so evidence_commit_sha/tree bind the final evidence head, and PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_RESULTS.json plus PACKAGE_CHECKER_PACKET.md are updated to the result actually reproducible at that head; or (b) the artifacts state explicitly and prominently that the recorded preflight and capsule-verifier results hold ONLY at 58b3620, that at the PR head the package deliberately returns BINDING-DEFECT, and that a re-cut capsule bound to the final head is a prerequisite of founder key enrollment and signing.
findings.authority_impact: NONE in the fail-open direction. The control fires correctly and fails CLOSED: zero_invocation true, providerSpawn 0, founder gate still KEY_ENROLLMENT. No false success, no widened ceiling, no executable behaviour change. The impact is that the package as submitted cannot be signed and consumed, and that three committed evidence claims are false at the commit containing them.
findings.narrow_correction_scope: Regenerate the out-of-tree capsule against the final evidence head and correct exactly three files: PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_RESULTS.json (executed_preflight + checks.binds_exact_final_head), CAPSULE_INDEX.json (capsule_verifier result and the bound frozen_head), PACKAGE_CHECKER_PACKET.md section 13. No source, no tool, no ceiling, no exclusion, no provider binding, no authority binding needs to change.

findings.title: The package commit silently removed the STALE-INTERMEDIATE-CANDIDATE markers from UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json, which still carries founder-fill placeholders and the retired V3 schema, and now ships as a first-class package artifact
findings.mechanism: Commit ce82c3b deliberately added __status: 'STALE-INTERMEDIATE-CANDIDATE', __superseded_by: 'UNSIGNED_ACTIVATION_MATERIAL_PACKET.json' and __reason: 'binds obsolete SHA + carried founder-fill placeholders; replaced by placeholder-free material packet'. Regenerating the file with tools/terminal0/lrcq/classify-and-packet.mjs — which has no knowledge of those hand-added markers — drops all three. The regenerated file still contains schema_version 'lrcq-activation-3', activation_v3_core_digest, no no_deploy / no_external_comms fields, and six placeholder values including provider_executable_path '<founder-fills-approved-executable-path>'. Nothing in the changed-path classification, the correction ledgers or the reproducibility record declares this removal. Separately, PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS.md section 6 documents only generate-run-manifest.mjs and refreeze-package.mjs, so a reviewer following the documented recipe never regenerates this file at all and cannot discover its provenance.
reproduction: git diff 39dea636 58b3620 -- .foundergate/evidence/lrcq-assurance-factory/UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json    # shows the three markers deleted
findings.actual_result: __status absent; schema_version 'lrcq-activation-3'; six '<founder-fills…>' / '<founder-mints…>' placeholders present; the file is listed in EVIDENCE_SET_INDEX.json and PACKAGE_SHA256_MANIFEST.json with no indication that it is superseded; no artifact anywhere in the wave declares the removal.
findings.required_result: Either the staleness markers are restored (or replaced by an equivalent, generator-emitted supersession field), or the package explicitly declares that UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json is a retained historical V3 gate packet superseded by UNSIGNED_ACTIVATION_MATERIAL_PACKET.json, and PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS.md section 6 lists every generator needed to reproduce the package.
findings.authority_impact: NONE. The file's founder_signature is null and confers_no_authority is true; no signed field carries its digest; preflight control PF-3 refuses any '<founder' placeholder that reaches an activation; and verifyActivation refuses schema lrcq-activation-3 outright (proven dynamically: V3_REFUSED_FOR_EXECUTION). The defect is founder-readability and evidence honesty, not authority.
findings.narrow_correction_scope: One field group in UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json (or its generator), plus one paragraph in PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS.md section 6. Regenerating the file changes its digest, so EVIDENCE_SET_INDEX.json and PACKAGE_SHA256_MANIFEST.json would be regenerated with it; nothing else.

findings.title: The re-freeze generator refuses a widened ceiling but accepts a REMOVED exclusion, silently emitting a founder-readable artifact keyed ten_mandatory_exclusions that lists nine
artifacts: the artifacts it generates: .foundergate/evidence/lrcq-provider-package-refreeze/LIMITS_AND_EXCLUSIONS.json and FOUNDER_ENROLLMENT_PACKET.json
findings.mechanism: Line 258 checks ceilings with strict equality against the CEILINGS table, so any edit refuses (CEILING_MISMATCH). Line 259 checks exclusions with `for (const x of EXCLUSIONS) if (packet[x] !== true)` — iterating the generator's own table. Deleting an entry from that table simply removes the iteration, so nothing refuses. The generator's EXCLUSIONS constant is a hand-maintained duplicate of activation-v4.mjs's authoritative V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS and is never asserted equal to it.
reproduction: in a disposable clone, edit tools/terminal0/lrcq/refreeze-package.mjs replacing '"no_deploy", "no_external_comms",' with '"no_external_comms",'
findings.actual_result: generator exit 0; LIMITS_AND_EXCLUSIONS.json ten_mandatory_exclusions contains 9 keys (no_deploy absent); FOUNDER_ENROLLMENT_PACKET.plain_language.what_the_run_may_never_do contains 9 entries; no warning is printed.
findings.required_result: The generator should assert its EXCLUSIONS table equals V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS from activation-v4.mjs (and its CEILINGS keys equal V4_SIGNED_LIMIT_FIELDS), refusing on any divergence, so a founder-readable exclusion inventory can never silently understate the signed contract.
findings.authority_impact: NONE. The signed activation payload still carries all ten exclusions as true (verified: no_deploy true in the regenerated packet), and verifyActivation enforces V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS independently — proven dynamically, 10/10 EXCLUSION_VIOLATION and 10/10 MISSING_FIELD. The exposure is a founder-readable artifact that could understate what the run may never do.
findings.narrow_correction_scope: Two assertion lines in tools/terminal0/lrcq/refreeze-package.mjs importing V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS and V4_SIGNED_LIMIT_FIELDS and comparing them to the local tables. No package artifact content changes.
